s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of systemic inflammation with skin, muscle, and mucous membrane involvement
salient_findings: Pruritic rash on trunk and upper extremities
Heliotrope rash and erythematous lip swelling
key_facts: 65-year-old man with history of hepatitis B, hepatitis C, rheumatoid arthritis, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and obesity
Presented with several months of facial swelling, dysphagia, and dysarthria
Developed pruritic rash on trunk and upper extremities
No personal or family history of angioedema
Medications included lisinopril, atorvastatin, albuterol, and ibuprofen
Discontinued etanercept six months before presentation
Vital signs were stable on arrival
Physical examination notable for anasarca and diffuse coalescent erythematous rash
Elevated C-reactive protein and erythrocyte sedimentation rate
Elevated transaminases
Elevated anti-Sjögren syndrome–related antigen A autoantibodies
High antinuclear antibody titers
Elevated creatine kinase
Positive myositis panel for anti-SAE antibodies

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Heliotrope rash, erythematous lip swelling, and elevated creatine kinase

shortlist.label: Polymyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated creatine kinase and positive myositis panel for anti-SAE antibodies

shortlist.label: Mixed connective tissue disease
shortlist.why_kept: Overlap of systemic inflammation, skin, and muscle involvement with high antinuclear antibody titers

shortlist.label: Sjögren's syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated anti-Sjögren syndrome–related antigen A autoantibodies and dry skin

shortlist.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: High antinuclear antibody titers and systemic inflammation with skin and muscle involvement

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with facial swelling, dysphagia, dysarthria, and a pruritic rash, along with elevated creatine kinase and a positive myositis panel for anti-SAE antibodies, is consistent with dermatomyositis. The heliotrope rash and erythematous lip swelling are also characteristic of this condition.

rejected.label: Polymyositis
rejected.why: The presence of a characteristic skin rash makes polymyositis less likely

rejected.label: Mixed connective tissue disease
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms do not fully align with the typical presentation of mixed connective tissue disease

rejected.label: Sjögren's syndrome
rejected.why: While the patient has elevated anti-Sjögren syndrome–related antigen A autoantibodies, the primary symptoms do not suggest Sjögren's syndrome as the main diagnosis

rejected.label: Systemic lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results do not fully meet the criteria for systemic lupus erythematosus
